metadata.title: Olive Table authored paraphrase evaluation
metadata.purpose: Small fixed diagnostic sample for category retrieval, typo robustness and out-of-domain rejection; not a production-quality estimate.
metadata.creation_protocol: Authored from the agreed intent names without inspecting backend FAQ question strings. Query text was withheld from backend implementation during initial authoring. These examples are distinct from the restaurant's reference knowledge, but their author knew the application scope.
metadata.split: Classifier fitting/development use separate authored utterance groups in training/data/intents.json, with augmentation confined to training groups. Reference FAQ documents supply lexical retrieval knowledge. This fixed diagnostic query file is withheld from fitting, candidate selection and threshold selection; if reused for tuning, treat it as development data. Its author knew the supported category names, so it is not an independent benchmark.

mode_definitions.baseline: Full application's baseline mode, with fresh state per query; raw retrieve() baseline is reported separately.
mode_definitions.enhanced: Full application's enhanced mode, including any enabled classifier and dialogue routing, with fresh state per query; raw retrieve() enhanced is reported separately.
